Mytra

Software Engineer

Software Engineer

About Mytra:

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

About the role

The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how and in what sequence; in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests. We are constantly solving dynamically changing multi-agent path finding and task allocation problems against a live fleet.

We are looking for someone smart, hungry, and genuinely excited by algorithmic and optimization problems, with solid backend fundamentals. This person will help define the behavior of our robotics fleet to make our system as optimized as possible.

Problems we solve:
Multi-agent path finding at fleet scale. Collision-free, time-feasible trajectories, where every bot's path may intersect and constrain every other's.
Task assignment under precedence constraints. Which bot does what, in what order, when the work has dependencies.
Storage and retrieval strategy. Where a payload should be stored based on a variety of metadata, and what to move out of the way to reach one that's buried.
Continuous replanning. Re-prioritizing and adapting to new or canceled work without stalling the fleet.
State truth and reconciliation. Mapping where everything is in the physical world in our digital twin; automating recovery when the physical and digital worlds differ; recovery from spills, maintenance zones, network drops, and more unpredictable problems!
Observability. Making a planning cycle legible enough to debug.
WMS integration. Mapping a customer's model of their work onto our system - and then using that data to optimize their deployment of the Mytra system.
Ideal Candidates
Genuinely like algorithmic and optimization problems. Search, scheduling, routing, constraint solving, graph problems; these are the kind of thing you choose to think about, and you have chased some of them down before.
You've written backend software that other people depended on: a service, an API, something with a database behind it.
You've worked directly with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres.
You can own a defined piece of work end to end from general direction rather than daily supervision.
You find answers on your own: you can identify ambiguity, know which questions to ask, and are proactive about getting answers quickly.
You learn fast, and you want to!
You are proficient in Go (or similar backend languages), or can be productive in it quickly.
You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently.
2+ years of production experience.
Nice to have:
Helpful, not required: any exposure to multi-agent path finding, task allocation, constraint problems, or other search based algorithms; Warehouse automation or AMR fleet management; working with a relational database at scale; experience with NATS or other message pub/sub tools; participated in an on call rotation for a live system with real customers
A Final Note:

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last

Benefits Include:
Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high-growth company backed by top-tier VCs
Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents
401(k) plans and employer-subsidized life insurance
Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table
Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together
Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity
Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit
Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases
Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters
Pay Notice

Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change.

This role requires on-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.

Pay Range for this position is:

$145,000 - $175,000 USD
